boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten documented, under-21-friendly UGA and Athens activities with no admission or purchase required.

cards.title: Take a photo at The Arch
cards.subtitle: North Campus, University of Georgia
cards.notes: Meet at Broad Street, take a few photos, then use the self-guided map to continue through North Campus at your own pace.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost campus-photo stop at UGA’s iconic gateway.
cards.evidence_claim: UGA Health Promotion lists taking a picture by the Arch among free things to do, and UGA describes it as a popular campus photo spot.
cards.source_title: Do It Sober — UGA Health Promotion
cards.access_notes: Outdoor landmark; no purchase or admission is indicated by UGA.

cards.title: Walk the botanical garden trails
cards.subtitle: State Botanical Garden of Georgia, Athens
cards.notes: Choose a display garden or nature trail and set an easy turnaround point before you start; grounds are open daily except UGA holidays.
cards.short_summary: Garden and trail time with free admission and parking.
cards.evidence_claim: The State Botanical Garden states that admission and parking are free, and its display gardens and nature trails are open daily.
cards.source_title: Location, Hours, Parking and Tours — State Botanical Garden of Georgia
cards.access_notes: Grounds hours are 7 a.m.–7 p.m. daily except UGA holidays; follow garden visitor guidelines.

cards.title: Watch sunset from North Campus Deck
cards.subtitle: North Campus Deck, University of Georgia
cards.notes: Bring a friend for a short sunset pause, keep the deck clear for vehicles, and head out together once daylight fades.
cards.short_summary: A free elevated view named by UGA’s alcohol-free activity guide.
cards.evidence_claim: UGA Health Promotion lists watching the sunset from the top of North Campus Deck as a free activity.
cards.source_title: Do It Sober — UGA Health Promotion
cards.access_notes: Parking may carry a fee; this card covers viewing the sunset, not parking.

cards.title: Relax beside the Herty Field fountain
cards.subtitle: Herty Field, North Campus
cards.notes: Use the fountain area for a conversation or quiet break, then pair it with a walk past nearby historic North Campus buildings.
cards.short_summary: A free outdoor pause at UGA’s original athletic field.
cards.evidence_claim: UGA Health Promotion lists relaxing by the fountain on Herty Field as a free activity.
cards.source_title: Do It Sober — UGA Health Promotion
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus space; no purchase or admission is indicated by UGA.

cards.title: Stroll Founders Memorial Garden
cards.subtitle: Founders Memorial Garden, North Campus
cards.notes: Walk the garden paths, look closely at the plantings, and use the adjacent North Campus landmarks for a longer self-guided loop.
cards.short_summary: A free campus garden stop with a documented UGA recommendation.
cards.evidence_claim: UGA Health Promotion lists relaxing at Founders Memorial Garden as a free activity, and UGA identifies it as a campus destination open to the public.
cards.source_title: Do It Sober — UGA Health Promotion
cards.access_notes: Outdoor garden; no purchase or admission is indicated by UGA.

cards.title: Browse the Georgia Museum of Art
cards.subtitle: East Campus, University of Georgia
cards.notes: Check the museum’s current exhibitions before you go, then give yourselves time to explore the permanent collection without rushing.
cards.short_summary: UGA’s official state art museum has free admission.
cards.evidence_claim: UGA’s self-guided tour identifies the Georgia Museum of Art as the official state museum of art and states that admission is free.
cards.access_notes: Closed Mondays, per UGA’s self-guided tour map; confirm exhibition hours before visiting.

cards.title: Ring the Chapel Bell for an occasion
cards.subtitle: Behind the Chapel, North Campus
cards.notes: Save this for a shared milestone or good news, then take a quick North Campus walk while the bell’s sound carries downtown.
cards.short_summary: A free, documented UGA tradition tied to accomplishments and special occasions.
cards.evidence_claim: UGA states that the Chapel Bell is rung to mark athletic victories, academic accomplishments, and other special occasions.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor landmark; UGA Health Promotion also lists ringing the Chapel Bell as free.

cards.entity_name: Richard B. Russell Building Special Collections Libraries
cards.title: Explore Special Collections galleries
cards.subtitle: 300 S. Hull Street, Athens
cards.notes: Start in the gallery areas, compare a few items that catch your eye, and leave time for rotating exhibits rather than trying to see everything.
cards.short_summary: Free public galleries with historical materials and changing exhibits.
cards.evidence_claim: UGA Libraries states that admission to the Special Collections Libraries is free and open to the general public.
cards.access_notes: Library states it is open 8 a.m.–5 p.m. weekdays and 1–5 p.m. Saturdays, with home-game-day closures.

cards.title: See what is growing at the Trial Gardens
cards.subtitle: 220 West Green Street, Athens
cards.notes: Walk the planted beds and containers, compare varieties, and keep the visit flexible because plant displays change with the growing season.
cards.short_summary: A free-to-visit research garden on UGA’s South Campus.
cards.evidence_claim: UGA Today reports that the Trial Gardens are always open to visitors free of charge.
cards.source_title: UGA holds Trial Gardens open house July 11 — UGA Today
cards.access_notes: The Trial Gardens contact page locates the gardens behind the Science Learning Center; nearby weekday parking may cost extra.

cards.title: Follow UGA’s self-guided North Campus tour
cards.subtitle: Start at the Visitors Center or The Arch
cards.notes: Download the map, choose several stops that interest your group, and take the route at your own pace instead of trying to complete every stop.
cards.short_summary: A self-paced campus walk supported by UGA’s downloadable tour map.
cards.evidence_claim: UGA Visitors Center provides a self-guided tour map for visitors to navigate campus at their own pace.
cards.source_title: Campus Tours and Information Sessions — UGA Visitors Center
cards.access_notes: The downloadable self-guided map is available without registration; parking is separate.
